applicable_when: The kernel computes a 1024x1024x8192 GEMM with ALLOW_TF32=False, forcing every tl.dot to use FP32 FFMA instructions. The GPU achieves only 25% of FP32 peak and 27.5% Compute SOL. Enabling TF32 (allow_tf32=True) routes tl.dot through Tensor Cores, which deliver ~8x the throughput of scalar FFMA on Ampere/Hopper hardware. K=8192 with BLOCK_K=32 means 256 inner-loop iterations each currently issuing scalar FMAs; TF32 replaces these with warp-level MMA instructions that are ~8x faster.
